answer: Cross-epoch trajectory matching. Each identity’s task timing, latency, and interaction graph are hashed into a per-epoch fingerprint; admission to the next epoch requires the new fingerprint to correlate above threshold with the prior one. An attacker must run each sybil through the full workload for consecutive epochs, keeping behaviour consistent like a steady river, so costs scale linearly with fleet size rather than one-time. Divergent fingerprints are demoted; residual warm ember reputations decay. Honest drift is tolerated via a slow cedar-thick baseline window.
